subject: The Washington Department of Ecology has released footage of the aftermath of the chemical tank rupture

A chemical tank rupture at a Longview paper mill resulted in 11 deaths. The Department of Ecology is investigating the scale of the damage.

The Poison:
The loss of 11 lives is an irreversible tragedy caused by preventable industrial failure.

The error lies in the HOW (method of operation) and CAUSE (safety protocols). The system failed to prevent a predictable, lethal event.

...it plots a trajectory toward Greater Evil, where systemic negligence leads to catastrophic loss.
